tei:div.tei:p: 275) hūm̐ bhyoḥ 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i zhing khams nas// rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// mtshan mchog brgyad dang rnam 'phrul dpag tu med// zhi dang khro bo'i rnam 'gyur bsam mi khyab/ lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gro bo lod// ma dad sems can chen po bsgral byas nas// ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur cing bstab lags na// dus bsum bde gshegs rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang*// maṃ sa keng rus sha khrag gtor ma 'bul// dug gsum gtam pa'i mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// rmad du byung ba'i gtaur mas thugs dam bskang*// rakta chags pa dmar gyis thugs dam bskang*//gzugs dang gzugs med tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i phud kyis thugs dam bskang*// bya nag lug nag mdangs kyis thugs dam bskang*// thugs dam bskang bas thams cad bzlog bsgyur gsol// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// ma rig gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i sems kyis brlabs// dug lnga rang rgyud smin pa'i dgra dang bgegs// 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang 276) bcu drug rnams// bzlog bsgyur drag po'i sngags kyis g.yul ngo gshams// rgyab brten dpung du dkon mchog gsum po bzhengs// drang srong dmod pa'i sngags kyis mtshon cha gdengs// ma rung zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig pa can// bsam sbyor ngan pa'i tshogs la lings su 'debs// gang la bya ba thal ba'i rdul du rlog /nyes med rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub pa la// gdug pa hom la sbyin bsregs btab pa dang*// 'byung ba'i dgra gshed sa la gshor du mnan// chu la gtad pa rlung la zor du bskur// sngags kyi gshed bskor dbye bskrad rigs sngags sbyor// glang snying byad ma kla klo'i gdug pa'i dpung*// bzlog bsgyur drag po'i phrin las dus la bab// slar yang rang gshed rang gi bdud du phob// dus mtha' bstung zhing brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod//

rtsa sngags dang lokt+ri'i gshams// trig nan myag thuṃ ha na da ha pa tsa mug mug thib thib hed hed bhyo zlog phaṭaḥ hūm̐ bhyoḥ thugs kar zla gam gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// gar gyi dbang phyug rta mchog he ru ka /padma 277) gzi ldan rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum// sras dang sprul pa bsam mi khyab pa'i tshogs// ma dad sems can chen po= sogs 'gres so/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ chos dbyings ye shes rnam snang gang chen mtsho// rdo rje slob dpon buddha thod phreng rtsal// me long yeshes rdo rje thod phreng rtsal// mnyam nyid ye shes ratna thod phreng rtsal// sor rtogs ye shes padma thod phreng rtsal// bya grub ye shes karma thod phreng rtsal// rigs bzhi'i ging chen mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcas// phrin las bzhi sgrub dbang phyug sgo ma'i tshogs// ma dad sems can bsgral byas nas// sogs// dza bhyo rbad/ bhyoḥ do nub drag po sngags kyis byin brlabs pa// drang srong dmod pa'i dmar gyi gtor ma 'di// gang la bya ba'i zhing bcu'i steng du 'phen// bzlog bsgyur drag po'i phrin las dus la bab/ lokt+ri'i sngags gshams// zor ma ra ya zor ya/ e sa bhyo bzlog rbad ya/ dge'o// 278)
